subject: Controls pack request — onboarding & offboarding artifacts, training attestations
messages:
From: Simon Park <security@allia-sec.com>
To: soojin_lee@redwood.com
Cc: monica_patel@redwood.com, neha_kapoor@redwood.com
Date: Sun, 14 Feb 2027 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Request: personnel controls evidence for SIG/SOC2 scope (onboarding/offboarding + training)

Hi Soojin,

Thanks again for taking our assessment. Acme Health is moving Redwood Inference into scope for a SIG assessment and they asked us to collect targeted artifacts for personnel controls focused on onboarding, background screening, training, and offboarding. To keep the request tight, could you provide the following by EOD Tuesday 2027-02-16: 

- Redacted background check summary for hires in the last 12 months (PII removed).
- Training completion export (role, module, completion date) for security awareness and data handling for 2026 Q4.
- Onboarding runbook describing account provisioning steps and owners (including third-party onboarding).
- Offboarding/deprovisioning checklist and evidence of last 6 leavers (date, access removed).
- Access matrix snapshot showing role-to-permission mapping for core services.

We appreciate redaction where appropriate. If anything is sensitive to share via email, a shared Drive link is fine (we will accept view-only). Also flag any controls that are outsourced or managed by partners so we can note them in the SIG questionnaire.

If the timeline is tight, let me know which items you can deliver and when; we can split the review.

Thanks,
Simon Park
Allia Security — Technical Assessment Lead
security@allia-sec.com

Attachments: requested_artifact_list_v1.pdf (list of items)
From: soojin_lee@redwood.com <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
To: Simon Park <security@allia-sec.com>
Cc: monica_patel@redwood.com, neha_kapoor@redwood.com, aditya_rao@redwood.com
Date: Sun, 14 Feb 2027 10:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Request: personnel controls evidence for SIG/SOC2 scope (onboarding/offboarding + training)

Simon —

Appreciate the clear list. I'll coordinate with HR (Monica) and People Ops (Neha) to compile. Quick notes: 

- Monica will own the background summaries and the training export.
- Neha will provide the onboarding/offboarding runbooks and deprovisioning checklist.
- Aditya will pull the access matrix snapshot from IAM and redact any service account IDs.

We should be able to get a cleaned bundle by Tue EOD; Monica will confirm shortly with the first drop. If anything cannot be shared by email because of containing PII, we'll upload to a view-only Drive folder and send the link.

Also: do you need hashes or timestamps for the files to prove immutability, or is a signed attestation sufficient?

Thanks —
Soojin Lee
Security Program Manager
Redwood Inference
soojin_lee@redwood.com

Attachments: none
From: monica_patel@redwood.com <monica_patel@redwood.com>
To: soojin_lee@redwood.com, Simon Park <security@allia-sec.com>
Cc: neha_kapoor@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 15 Feb 2027 14:18:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Request: personnel controls evidence for SIG/SOC2 scope (onboarding/offboarding + training)

On Mon, Feb 15, 2027 at 10:05 AM Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com> wrote:
> Simon —
> 
> Appreciate the clear list. I'll coordinate with HR (Monica) and People Ops (Neha) to compile. Quick notes: 
> 
> - Monica will own the background summaries and the training export.
> - Neha will provide the onboarding/offboarding runbooks and deprovisioning checklist.
> - Aditya will pull the access matrix snapshot from IAM and redact any service account IDs.

Hi all — attaching the first set. Items included here (redacted as requested):

1) redwood_training_completion_2026-Q4.csv — columns: employee_id (redacted), role, module_name, completion_date, status. We removed employee names and replaced with randomized IDs; HR can map them internally if you need sample PII for verification.
2) background_check_summary_redacted.pdf — summarizes background results for hires (dates and outcome only). All PII removed.

Let me know if you require the underlying vendor attestations (we can request a copy from our screening provider but that will take ~3 business days).

Attachments: redwood_training_completion_2026-Q4.csv (CSV), background_check_summary_redacted.pdf (PDF)

Thanks,
Monica Patel
Head of People Operations
Redwood Inference
monica_patel@redwood.com
From: soojin_lee@redwood.com <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
To: Simon Park <security@allia-sec.com>, Ruth Gomez <ruth.gomez@acmehealth.com>
Cc: monica_patel@redwood.com, neha_kapoor@redwood.com, aditya_rao@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 16 Feb 2027 15:04:00 -0800
Subject: Final delivery: onboarding/offboarding runbook, access matrix + evidence links

Simon / Ruth —

Per the timeline, we've uploaded the remaining artifacts to a view-only Drive folder and attached a brief runbook excerpt here. Bundle contents: 

- onboard-deprovision-runbook_v2.md — step-by-step provisioning and deprovisioning workflows, owners, and slack escalation channel.
- access_matrix_snapshot.png — role-to-permission mapping exported from IAM (service accounts redacted).
- redwood_training_completion_2026-Q4.csv (previously attached)
- background_check_summary_redacted.pdf (previously attached)

Drive link (view-only): https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3cRedwood-SOC2-Evidence
HubSpot evidence record: https://app.hubspot.com/records/ENG-9274

We performed PII redaction on the background check summaries and replaced employee names with internal IDs in the training CSV. If you need vendor-signed screening attestations, Monica can request them; ETA ~3 business days.

Next steps: if this satisfies the SIG assessor scope, can we schedule a 30-minute walkthrough Thurs 2027-02-18 at 10:00 AM PT? If that works, I'll send a calendar invite and include a brief runbook walkthrough deck.

Thanks for the fast turnaround.

—Soojin
Soojin Lee
Security Program Manager
Redwood Inference
soojin_lee@redwood.com

Attachments: onboard-deprovision-runbook_v2.md (Markdown excerpt), access_matrix_snapshot.png (PNG)
